source: Modified UNIFAC (Dortmund): subgroup volumes R and areas Q, and main-group interaction parameters a, b, c of Psi_nm = exp(-(a_nm + b_nm T + c_nm T^2)/T) (a in K, b dimensionless, c in 1/K; a pair entry gives a, b, c for n = first, m = second and a_reverse, b_reverse, c_reverse for n = second, m = first), as DWSIM 10.2.5 ships them (DWSIM.Thermodynamics.dll resources modfac.txt and modfac_ip.txt), from U. Weidlich, J. Gmehling, Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 26 (1987) 1372; J. Gmehling, J. Li, M. Schiller, Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 32 (1993) 178; and the later published revisions modfac_ip.txt cites (Gmehling et al. 1998, 2002; Wittig et al. 2001, 2003; Lohmann et al. 2001; Jakob et al.). Each pair keeps the file's reference number. Written by tools/compound-import/groups.mjs.

provenance.files: modfac.txt (6703 bytes, SHA-256 275b73f9f6524156b1a733d1d921e9af065ada901c4dc387d90387b95f7fac95), modfac_ip.txt (45786 bytes, SHA-256 bc50dd0892752ad5214534b627b29c1fbb8fd875d8634002b6d02d7cce744439)
provenance.renamed: subgroup 26 "CHO" (ether, main group 13) to CHO_ether, as subgroup 20 is the aldehyde CHO; subgroup 83 "c-CH2O[1/2 CH2]" to c-CH2O[1/2CH2] (no space in a key); each keeps its DWSIM text as label
provenance.left_out: 527 placeholder lines (all six parameters 0, no reference or reference 0: no data); malformed lines 2-56: seven fields after the group numbers, no reference; 14-43: four parameter fields and a reference of 0; the pairs of main groups 49, for which modfac.txt gives no subgroup

water_hydrocarbon_block.source: Fitted in batch 2026-11-11-aqueous-solvents by tools/aqueous-solvents/group-derived-pairs.mjs (fitBlock): the constant terms of CH2-H2O and H2O-CH2 to the mutual solubility of n-hexane and water at 25 C (hexane in water 2.5e-6, water in hexane 5.3e-4, mole fractions), of ACH-H2O and H2O-ACH to benzene and water (4.1e-4, 3.0e-3), each as 1/gamma at infinite dilution; the solubilities are quoted from memory of the standard sources and are to be checked (plan section 2). Rounded to 0.1 K. Replaces the table's pairs of these main groups with water for a mixture of water and compounds whose groups all lie in hydrocarbon_main_groups (no polar group).
